Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. Tenderer should have fulfilled all criteria's which are stated in Tender Document (i.e. stated in Tender Data Sheet, Particular
Conditions of Contract & Technical Specification). In case of shortage of any requirement, the tenderer will be treated as non-
responsive.
2. The Tenderer must have Manufacturing Authorization form the respective satellite company. Any authorization from
reseller/partner will not be accepted.
3. The Tenderer shall be the direct reseller/partner for at least 5 years of the Satellite Company.
4. The Satellite company must have the capacity of capturing and selling 30 cm resolution stereo image.
5. At least one experience for successfully supplying of similar image (stereo image, 30 cm resolution) for at least 1000 sq. km for
any government department within last 02 years in Bangladesh.
6. The Tenderer/Supplier/Consultant must have experience in stereo image processing.
7. Tenderer should submit up-to-date Trade license, VAT and Tax Certificate.
8. Tenderer should submit their Liquid assets certificate according to attached format in TDS otherwise declare as non-responsive.
The minimum amount of Liquid Assets is one crore taka.
9. The required average annual turnover shall be at least three crore taka in best three years in the last 5 years.
10. After completion the tender opening process, if unable to download any important document of the tenderer, which considered
to tender evaluation process, may be treated as nonresponsive
